purpose: Local development measurements used to choose the v6 conversation critical path. These are seeded synthetic cases, not held-out conversational acceptance.
host: Human-supplied Mac Studio M4 Max, 16 CPU cores, 40 GPU cores, 64 GB unified memory

current_two_stage_seconds.question: Were any other checks required before the manager approved the activation?
What else, if anything, needed to happen before the supplier could be activated?
Did any other mandatory checks need to be completed before the supplier was released?
What criteria would determine if Operations should approve an urgent supplier in this proposed scenario?
We can leave that point open. Which role or source would help us understand it later?

retrieval_profile.finding: Retrieval is not the present multi-second bottleneck. The current Python BM25 rebuild and full vector scan still need a derived index before the corpus grows materially.

decisions: Keep the interview ledger and typed semantic frame in SQLite as the authoritative record.
Use one local writer call and one focused local review call on the ordinary critical path.
Update coverage from question identity and narrow explicit facts instead of running a general coverage model before every question.
Keep both local models resident for 30 minutes and use the same 8192-token context size to prevent Ollama runner reloads.
Delay spoken thinking filler until 2.2 seconds; ordinary measured turns should proceed directly to the checked question.
Prototype a rebuildable hybrid evidence index when real Atlas evidence is attached; do not replace the authoritative ledger with a vector database.
limits: The timing sample is small, warm and synthetic; p95 long-session and concurrent speech-load measurements remain open.
The local semantic reviewer remains fallible; deterministic structure, source, correction and premise checks remain in force.
No real Atlas evidence adapter, multi-user authority or publication path is enabled.
